title: C-17 device bind protocol
note: Day-2 skeleton for U1/U4/F1/R3. `hello_sig` and the BIND_* codes are final; the envelope field list may still gain fields without breaking existing members.

h.description: admin host:port the App must connect to

fp.description: core identity fp8 = SHA-256(core_pub)[:16]. NOT the TLS fingerprint.

t.description: 26-char base32 bind ticket, one use, 10 minutes

tls.description: optional SPKI pin; rotates, never the identity anchor

core_pub.description: base64 raw Ed25519 public key of the core identity

kex_pub.description: base64 raw X25519 ephemeral public key for this ticket

hello_sig.description:
base64 Ed25519 over: 'vade-bind-hello-v1
' || kex_pub || '
' || challenge || '
' || SHA256(ticket) || '
' || admin_host

ticket.description: plaintext ticket; everything else is inside ct

eph_pub.description: device ephemeral X25519 public key, base64

ct.description: AES-256-GCM ciphertext of {password, device_pub, alg, label, hardware_backed, ts, sig}

raw.description: base64 32-byte raw key or an ssh-ed25519 line (converted on import)

errorCodes.BIND_UNAUTHORIZED: ticket unknown, expired, already consumed, or a verification step failed (no oracle)
errorCodes.BIND_FINGERPRINT_MISMATCH: the App's pinned fp8 differs from this core
errorCodes.BIND_HELLO_SIG_INVALID: hello_sig did not verify against the pinned core_pub
errorCodes.BIND_DEVICE_LIMIT: 5 devices per account; nothing is evicted automatically
errorCodes.BIND_KEY_UNSUPPORTED: alg missing or key encoding malformed
errorCodes.BIND_SETUP_LOCKED: setup is in progress in another session

atomicity: Verify-then-delete: decryption, signature and limits must all pass before DELETE ... WHERE consumed_at IS NULL; a failed attempt must NOT burn the ticket (test: wrong signature then correct signature succeeds).
